objects.original: A set-valued representative using a specified fallback.
objects.reconstructed: A function that returns an element of a subset using a chosen fallback when necessary.
objects.evidence: AutoSamplingTheory/TechnicalLemmas/StochasticProcesses/CompactStateRepresentative.lean:10; The definition body is the membership conditional with a subtype constructor.

domains.original: Any type E, subset K and fallback in K.
domains.reconstructed: E is an arbitrary type; K is any subset of E; fallback is a member of the subtype K; x is any element of E. Output lies in the subtype K.
domains.evidence: AutoSamplingTheory/TechnicalLemmas/StochasticProcesses/CompactStateRepresentative.lean:10; The section has arbitrary E and K, no hidden topology.

quantifiers.original: For every x∈E return a member of K.
quantifiers.reconstructed: Definition universally parameterized by E,K,then fallback in K,then x in E.
quantifiers.evidence: AutoSamplingTheory/TechnicalLemmas/StochasticProcesses/CompactStateRepresentative.lean:10; fallback and x are ordinary definition arguments.

assumptions.original: Only fallback membership; no compactness or measurability premise.
assumptions.reconstructed: Only the supplied fallback in K is required, so K is inhabited. No topology, metric, measure, or algebraic structure is assumed.
assumptions.evidence: AutoSamplingTheory/TechnicalLemmas/StochasticProcesses/CompactStateRepresentative.lean:10; Classical membership decision is a logical implementation device, not a source assumption.

conclusion.original: Keep x when x∈K, otherwise return fallback.
conclusion.reconstructed: If x belongs to K, return the subtype element consisting of x and its membership proof; otherwise return fallback.
conclusion.evidence: AutoSamplingTheory/TechnicalLemmas/StochasticProcesses/CompactStateRepresentative.lean:10; The true/false branches exactly reproduce the source formula.

scopes.original: Literal pointwise definition on all E; not a geometric projection.
scopes.reconstructed: The test is pointwise membership. In the first branch the output's ambient value is exactly x; in the other branch it is the ambient value of fallback. This is not asserted to be a metric projection or to have any continuity/measurability property.
scopes.evidence: AutoSamplingTheory/TechnicalLemmas/StochasticProcesses/CompactStateRepresentative.lean:10; The separate measurable_restrictState theorem adds measurable-set assumptions only for that different claim; they are not part of this definition.

constant_dependencies.reconstructed: The result depends only on K,fallback,x (with proof fields carrying subtype membership); no constant or limit is involved.
constant_dependencies.evidence: AutoSamplingTheory/TechnicalLemmas/StochasticProcesses/CompactStateRepresentative.lean:10; No arbitrary off-source choice replaces the specified fallback.
